name: Baboons
overview: Scripture affirms that God created all living creatures on earth according to their kinds, including the beasts of the earth such as baboons (Genesis 1:24). All beasts belong to the Lord, who sovereignly owns the forest and the cattle upon a thousand hills (Psalms 50:10). The Bible also provides guidance on distinguishing clean and unclean animals, noting that certain beasts, identified by their characteristics, are considered unclean (Leviticus 11:27; Deuteronomy 14:7). While baboons are not explicitly named, they fall under the category of beasts created by God, reflecting His wisdom and order in creation.
